notes.title: Manglepaw Soundtrack Now Available!
notes.content: The soundtrack to Manglepaw is now available! Enjoy 27 dreamy tracks from the game, which are sure to evoke feelings of train stations and lizards.

notes.title: New Game from Manglepaw dev - Stardust Demon!!!
notes.content:
Here's our new game!! It's a retro metroidvania. Check it out and wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815500/Stardust_Demon/

It's a different genre than Manglepaw but there will also be some old-skool 3D art, surreal vibes and cool music, and puzzles here and there. If you like our work, wishlisting really helps us out and enables us to do more. Thank you!!
